subject: FW: Heritage Roots Buyer Inc. - $1,750MM Term Loan B - Launch / Lender Call Monday 10:30am ET
body:
Harbor Point launch below. Lender call Monday 10:30am ET, commitments due Tuesday the 28th.

-----Original Message-----
From: Leveraged Finance Syndicate <syndicate@harborpointsec.example>
Sent: Friday, July 17, 2026 11:02 AM
Subject: Heritage Roots Buyer Inc. - $1,750MM Term Loan B - Launch

Harbor Point Securities, as Left Lead Arranger, is pleased to announce the launch of the $1,750 million Term Loan B for Heritage Roots Buyer Inc.

Borrower:            Heritage Roots Buyer Inc.
Facility:            $1,750 million Term Loan B
Spread:              S+400-425 bps
Floor:               0.00%
OID:                 98.50-99.00
Tenor:               5 years (with a 91-day springing maturity inside the existing Secured Notes if more than $700 million remains outstanding)
Call Protection:     101 soft call for 6 months
Use of Proceeds:     Repay outstanding borrowings under the existing facilities, general corporate purposes and related fees and expenses
Business:            Heritage Roots is a subscription family-history and storytelling platform
Arrangers:           Harbor Point Securities (Left) / Blue Ridge Financial / Northgate Markets / Kestrel Bank / Ashgrove Capital Markets / Westbrook & Co. / Copper Hill Securities

Timing:
Lender Call:         Monday, July 20th @ 10:30 AM ET
Commitments Due:     Tuesday, July 28th at 12:00 PM ET

A public-side presentation and the term sheet are available on the arranger deal site (https://dealsite.harborpointsec.example/heritage-roots).

Harbor Point Securities - Leveraged Finance Syndicate - This communication is intended only for the named recipient.
